notes: All 6 required searches ran this time, plus 1 extra on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act. The superintelligence, extinction, pause, China and "AI safety" searches returned nothing mentioning Keith Self; the official-site search returned only the PRIVACY Act and FY26 NDAA amendment releases already recorded. An earlier run had also opened the first three pages of his press releases (30 releases, 16 December 2025 to 12 November 2026); none besides the PRIVACY Act release mentions AI. The PRIVACY Act release was reopened this run: his full sentence is "Americans' Fourth Amendment right to be secure in their privacy does not disappear just because of new technology or artificial intelligence," (15 July 2026); the quote kept is a continuous excerpt of it. The September 2025 NDAA amendment release describes an AI amendment in press office wording; his own quoted words there do not mention AI (left out of statements; military use would be D anyway). Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, led by Casar): search results describe the cosponsors as Democrats plus possibly Nathaniel Moran; no source seen names Keith Self, but the congress.gov cosponsor list was not opened. No House letter about AI risk signed or led by him was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions).
